observations.statement: Statement::fields has 64 fields in structured formal order, including tier placement, timestamp at index44, confirmations45/46 and ownership56..63. observations.deferred_flush: Queue is taken before fallible per-transaction writes; child state applies only after all writes. A flush error may leave queue drained. end_block calls expect before HostExecution moves phase to CommitInterrupted. FFI catches panic without rebuilding the service.
observations.recover: Rollback calls recover_current on latest durable application snapshot, recovers nullifier boundary, rebuilds App then resets phase Idle. It is an explicit operation, not an automatic consequence of FFI failure.
observations.commit: Nullifiers commit then application batch persists, then root/nullifier-complete/capacity work remains fallible. Errors need not mean the durable old state. Recovery must choose the actual authenticated durable boundary; caller coordination and store implementation assumptions remain owned joins.
observations.source_tests: Canceled commit and stale-snapshot commit tests require explicit rollback before replay and later reopen/readback. This review did not run those tests.
